_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score almost never leaves its band and 7-day base rate is a coil; no breaker visible in momentum, funding, or flows.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Anxiety; narrative implies distribution pressure but no opposing phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d momentum stays near 50 and funding holds ~0.01% with no range break
next_move.invalidated_if: momentum leaves mid-range with funding flipping negative on fast selloff, or ETF flows + CVD thrust break momentum higher
